name: CrowdRelay — CrowdRelayOS opportunity application executor
description: Auto-submits only free, reversible, email-addressed opportunities already approved by Rust policy.

parameters.jsCode:
const e=$json;if(!e||e.type!=='crowdrelay.opportunity.application_requested'||e.version!==1) throw new Error('Unsupported opportunity event');const d=e.data??{};if(d.payment_execution_allowed!==false||Number(d.application_fee_minor||0)!==0||d.requires_contract||d.exclusive) throw new Error('Guardrail violation: paid/contractual/exclusive application');const to=String(d.contact_email||'').trim();if(!to.includes('@')) throw new Error('No email executor for this opportunity');const m=d.metadata&&typeof d.metadata==='object'?d.metadata:{};const epk=String(m.epk_url||'https://virya.music/pl/epk/');const subject=String(m.application_subject||`Virya × ${d.title||d.organization} — zgłoszenie zespołu`).slice(0,220);const body=String(m.application_body||`Cześć,

zgłaszamy VIRYA do ${d.title||'Waszego wydarzenia'}. Jesteśmy zespołem modern metal z Wrocławia, łączącym progresję, metalcore i elektronikę.

EPK: ${epk}
Muzyka: https://virya.music/

Jeżeli potrzebujecie dodatkowych materiałów lub informacji technicznych, podeślemy je od razu.

Pozdrawiamy,
VIRYA`);return [{json:{event_id:e.id,action_id:d.action_id,opportunity_id:d.opportunity_id,SendTo:to,SendSubject:subject,SendBody:body}}];

const src=$('Validate safe application').item.json||{};const sent=$json||{};return [{json:{action_id:src.action_id,claim_token:$('Resolve provider execution claim').item.json.claim_token,status:'succeeded',provider_reference:String(sent.id||sent.messageId||sent.threadId||'gmail').slice(0,240),metadata:{event_id:src.event_id,provider:'gmail',domain_transition:'submitted'},occurred_at:new Date().toISOString()}}];

parameters.jsCode: const src=$('Resolve provider execution claim').item.json||{}; throw new Error(`Provider outcome ambiguous for action ${src.action_id||'unknown'}; claim retained to prevent automatic duplicate`);
